source: NACA MR L5G09a / WR L-594 (Gardner 1945), NTRS 19930093653, figure 1 (blade-form curves), page 12 rendered at 300 dpi by naca-archive's debug-figs workflow. Traced with digitize_track.py (fig1_l594_trace_config.json); calibration: x (r/R) 0 at 889 px, 0.2 per 189.4 px; zero line y=2368 px, 4 deg = 0.1 h/b = 0.02 b/D per 187 px. Check: theta-beta at 0.75R reads -0.01 deg.
propeller: Hamilton Standard No. 6507A-2, three blades, average design lift coefficient 0.4, diameter 12 ft 10 in, gear ratio 2:1, P&W R-2800-59, Republic P-47D
notes: b/D from r/R 0.12 (shank) to 0.95; twist drawn from 0.25; h/b from 0.14.

Read by eye: b/D at 0.15 and 0.20; twist at 0.15 and 0.20 (extrapolated along the curve), and 0.80-0.95 (the tracer loses the line on a heavy grid line at 0.78; the curve ends at -4.5 deg at 0.90, extended to 0.95 at the same slope); h/b at 0.90-0.95 (extrapolated).
